scope: Repair a separate narrated-film copy. No change to original MP4, application, shared release artifacts or HackTribe.

diagnosis.cause: Original edit deliberately muted score from 33 to 48 seconds although only one native label was audible. AAC decodes normally; this was a long editorial soundtrack gap, not truncated narration or corrupt stream.
diagnosis.applicationBoundary: At approximately 46 seconds the native capture selects Precipitation without a second captured label. This film repair restores soundtrack continuity and preserves authentic app audio; it does not repair or verify native player behavior, physical vibration or screen reader.

changes.change: Restore existing deterministic score muted by original edit; duck 12dB around existing 35.2-36.5s app label.
Retain full final narration; fade remaining music over 200ms, remove only last two picture frames to satisfy strict <180s.

sources.role: All picture and decoded narration/native audio
Existing deterministic original score reconstructed locally without original blanket mute
Original muted score subtracted only inside correction window
Source capture/build lineage, including emulator limits

rights: Existing narration asset permissions retained. Existing locally composed/synthesized music is project-created under MIT, without third-party samples. No new paid audio generated.

perceptualReview.method: One fresh Gemini 3.8 Flash multimodal request receives actual complete rendered audio bytes, no supplied script or earlier verdict. Automated model perception; not human listening.
perceptualReview.reportedCoverage: Complete audio, six consecutive ~30s ranges, specific 35-70s and ending checks
perceptualReview.finding: Continuous music across 45-47s; clear single Evaporation label; full closing CTA; no material issues.
perceptualReview.limits: Model timestamps are approximate; objective sample timing and source checks take precedence. No video/physical-device inference.

visualReview.method: Editor inspected 23 output frames across all scenes, targeted native interval and final frame; full 4318-frame decode and SSIM comparison against original.
visualReview.findings: Captions and final card legible and preserved. Native scene shows genuine original app states.
visualReview.limits: Sampled visual inspection is not continuous motion playback.

publication.afterUpload: Anonymous GET final URL, compare downloaded SHA256 and ffprobe duration. A local file is not jury-accessible.
